tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background — deep olive. The brand is dark-first; never use white pages.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, rank strip, product cards, hero visual panel.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Product image wells and bottle bodies inside cards.

tokens.name: surface-night
tokens.usage: Footer and the darkest bands.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: 1px hairlines, card borders, quiet button outlines.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text (sand) on surface, surface-raised and surface-night. 13:1 on surface.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Body copy and descriptions on any olive surface.

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Small stencil labels and meta (size, notes) — 14px+ only, on surface or surface-raised.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: The brand colour: primary buttons, prices, insignia, eyebrows, the General Elite option. Text in gold is fine at 14px+ on any olive surface.

tokens.name: gold-deep
tokens.usage: Decoration only: bottle caps, metal details. Never for text.

tokens.name: on-gold
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a gold fill (buttons, badges, top bar).

tokens.name: madame-rose
tokens.usage: Madame General (women's line) accent — replaces gold inside that line only. Text on it uses on-gold.

tokens.name: madame-wine
tokens.usage: Madame General line surface — replaces surface-raised inside that line. ink and madame-rose read on it.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight gaps: label to title, icon to text.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gaps between buttons and chips; small card padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding, gaps inside sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page side padding, rank card padding.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of a page section.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges ("الأكثر طلبًا").

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, chips — the brand is sharp, almost square.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and panels.

tokens.name: radius-bottle
tokens.usage: Bottle silhouettes only.
